question.knowledge_point: Calculating Sums and Scalar Multiplication of More Than Two Vectors
question.worked_solution:
To compute $d-(3e+f),$ we just need to perform the required operations with each component separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}d-(3e+f) & =9i+7j+4k-(3(-i+2k)+(i+7j-9k)) \\  & =9i+7j+4k-((-3i+6k)+(i+7j-9k)) \\  & =9i+7j+4k-(-2i+7j-3k) \\  & =11i+7k\end{aligned}
$$
